description_en: Replaces the certificate of an additional domain name
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-domain-extension-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-extension-id de-bp1rp7ta00000 --server-certificate-id 1231579xxxxxxxx_166f8204689_1714763408_709981xxx --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDomainExtensionAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name that is associated with the additional certificate to be replaced
parameters.name: domain_extension_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new certificate
parameters.name: server_certificate_id
